concept.title: Defogging logic
concept.shortdesc: To reduce the likelihood of fogging up the inside of the windshield, air intake and A/C are automatically controlled according to certain conditions and reflected in modes such as or .

keywords.indexterm: windshield defrosting and defogging defogging logic

section.title: Canceling or restoring automatic defogging logic for manual climate control system

li.p: Select SettingsVehicleClimateAuto Defog from the infotainment system screen.
To set the auto defog function, turn the blower on, change the airflow direction to (), and touch the recirculation/outside air selection button at least 5 times within 3 seconds.
When the auto defog function is set, the indicator on the windshield defroster button will blink 6 times at approximately 0.25-second intervals

To cancel the auto defog function or to set it again, change the airflow direction from another mode back to (), and touch the recirculation/outside air selection button at least 5 times within 3 seconds.
When the auto defog function is canceled, the indicator on the windshield defroster button will blink 3 times at approximately 0.5-second intervals.

section.p: The air intake control button indicator light will blink 3 times to indicate that the defogging logic has been canceled or restored to the programmed status.
The defog logic status will reset if the 12V battery has been discharged or disconnected.

section.title: Canceling or restoring automatic defogging logic for automatic climate control system
section.p: Select SettingsVehicleClimateAuto Defog from the infotainment system screen.
The defog logic status will reset if the 12V battery has been discharged or disconnected.

note.p: The infotainment system may change after software updates. For more information, refer to the user’s manual provided in the infotainment system and the quick reference guide.
